genre_target: 学术演讲方法详解页（Explaining Equations on Slides）
domain_context: 托福独立与综合写作：理论基础与工程实践权衡
communicative_intent_zh: 我这一段想在 PPT 上出现核心损失函数或注意力公式时，用 4 句通俗、精准的口语把公式背后的物理/几何直觉讲透，而不是在台上干巴巴念希腊字母。
prompt_zh: 【深度病段修改诊所 3：专治头重脚轻长主语 + 散装短句堆砌（Top-Heavy Subject & Choppy Flow）】下方议论/分析段落使用了烂大街的万能模板句且缺乏具象实例支撑。请砍掉全部套话外壳，并运用 `L021`（一句话具象行业微观案例法）重写该段。
source_material_or_draft: Time series imputation is very important in the era of big data. Existing generative models delve into the data distribution but are too slow and fail when missing rates are high. We propose FlowImp, a novel framework that uses conditional flow matching and frequency guidance. Extensive experiments show that FlowImp achieves state-of-the-art results on all benchmarks.
structural_constraints: S1 [先讲直觉目标 Intuition First]：Before looking at the math at the bottom of the slide, here is the simple physical intuition we want to capture.
S2 [日常/物理类比 Physical Analogy]：When two sensors monitor the same mechanical shaft, genuine vibrations share a consistent phase lag, whereas random electrical glitches fire out of phase.
S3 [指向公式核心项 Point to Key Term]：That is exactly what the red penalty term $\|\Delta \Phi\|_1$ inside the softmax does: it measures phase mismatch between channels.
S4 [一句话总结效果 Operational Effect]：Whenever two channels fall out of phase, this term suppresses their attention weight automatically.
target_defects_to_fix: 头重脚轻长主语 + 散装短句堆砌（Top-Heavy Subject & Choppy Flow）

domain_context: 具身智能视觉运动策略与仿真到真实迁移
communicative_intent_zh: 我这一段想解读主实验大表（Table 1）：既报告全局胜率，又挑出最有代表性的对比案例，解释为什么竞争对手在那里跌倒而我们稳赢。
prompt_zh: 【多段贯通写作实战 1：Failure_Mode_Report 核心章节连写】参照全文样板 `FT18 (科研实验反常现象与极端工况诊断报告全文：为何高容量注意力模型在强随机游走序列上退化及改进方案)` 的段落蓝图链 `BP32 -> BP19 -> BP20`，围绕你自己的研究方向（深度学习 / 时间序列 / 生成模型 / 具身智能）写出连续 3 个逻辑咬合的自然段，并标注段间过渡钩子（`L027`）。
source_material_or_draft: As shown in Table 1, our model gets the best MSE on ETTm1, ETTm2, Weather, and Traffic. On Weather dataset, our MSE is 0.165, which is 12% lower than PatchTST. On Traffic, our MSE is 0.382, which beats iTransformer. This proves our model is the best.
structural_constraints: S1 [全局统治力概述 Overall Dominance]：Table 1 summarizes the multivariate forecasting results, where [Our Model] achieves the lowest error in [X] out of [Y] dataset-horizon configurations.

S2 [对比流派 1 的差距与原因 Contrast vs. Family 1]：Compared with channel-independent baselines such as [Baseline A], our method reduces average MSE by [X%] on [Dataset], where strong cross-sensor coupling is critical.

S3 [对比流派 2 在困难场景下的崩溃 Contrast vs. Family 2 under Hard Regime]：Furthermore, while [Baseline B] performs competitively at short horizons ($H=96$), its error escalates by [Y%] at $H=720$ due to [Failure Mechanism].
S4 [回扣本文核心机制 Mechanistic Confirmation]：By contrast, our [Core Module] bounds long-range drift, maintaining a [Z%] margin over the second-best baseline at $H=720$.

prompt_zh: 【多段贯通写作实战 2：整篇小作文 / 演讲 / Rebuttal 闭环构建】结合今日所学蓝图 `BP43` 与全文样板 `FT18` 的后半部分（`BP21 -> BP23`），完成一篇包含“破题/总起 → 核心机制/正方论证 → 让步反驳/消融归因 → 边界收束”的完整短文，并用 `L030` 七维自检表逐项核验。
source_material_or_draft: Time series imputation is very important in the era of big data. Existing generative models delve into the data distribution but are too slow and fail when missing rates are high. We propose FlowImp, a novel framework that uses conditional flow matching and frequency guidance. Extensive experiments show that FlowImp achieves state-of-the-art results on all benchmarks.
structural_constraints: S1 [先讲直觉目标 Intuition First]：Before looking at the math at the bottom of the slide, here is the simple physical intuition we want to capture.
S2 [日常/物理类比 Physical Analogy]：When two sensors monitor the same mechanical shaft, genuine vibrations share a consistent phase lag, whereas random electrical glitches fire out of phase.
S3 [指向公式核心项 Point to Key Term]：That is exactly what the red penalty term $\|\Delta \Phi\|_1$ inside the softmax does: it measures phase mismatch between channels.
S4 [一句话总结效果 Operational Effect]：Whenever two channels fall out of phase, this term suppresses their attention weight automatically.
